scientific_question: Can the same three/four coordinates capture a stable and sufficient expert image when they span orthogonal token-level task-error modes instead of independent batch means, temporal chords, or Muon-whitened matrices?

causal_source.rule: Reconstruct scratch step zero exactly. Candidate directions may depend only on a discovery token split, its step-zero logits, and deterministic Walsh masks. The endpoint is used only for coordinate fitting and held-out scoring.

jacobian_basis.coordinate_zero: Negative gradient of the mean token cross entropy plus the production router auxiliary losses over all 2048 discovery tokens.
jacobian_basis.coordinates_one_to_three: Negative gradients of signed token cross entropy under the first three non-DC Walsh functions over flattened token index. Each mask has zero mean, unit magnitude, equal norm, and is orthogonal to the others and the DC direction.
jacobian_basis.router: Router directions are differentiated through the same masked token losses; auxiliary losses appear only in the DC coordinate.
jacobian_basis.interpretation: This is a deterministic randomized-Jacobian range sketch in task/token space. The structured transform chooses error probes; it is not the final weight generator.
jacobian_basis.anti_leakage: No endpoint tensor, target chord, held-out token, terminal activation, or optimizer state orients a mask or gradient.

controls.token_compute_match: Each bank uses 2048 discovery tokens, identical to four raw-gradient microbatches of 2x256 tokens; coordinate count is unchanged.
controls.fixed_structured: Rerun the same matched-budget fixed local BlockFHT control.

evaluation.primary_metric: Exact nonlinear held-out residual-write recovery on the fixed step-zero activation frame.
secondary_metrics: discovery-A versus discovery-B per-atom Jacobian-span overlap
Jacobian-sketch improvement over the token-compute-matched raw gradient bank

interpretation.pass_both_banks: A token-functional Jacobian image is sufficient at the paper-scale coordinate budget. Authorize only a 124M 5-TPP online Jacobian-sketch acquisition; generated training stays blocked.
interpretation.improve_but_fail: The functional range sketch is causally useful but incomplete. Use its residual to preregister an activation/error KFAC eigenbasis at the same coordinates.
interpretation.no_improvement: Reject token-mask sketching and move directly to activation/error KFAC factors; do not tune masks, coordinates, or optimizer.
interpretation.authorization: Only this zero-update offline oracle is authorized. Generated-expert training, MFU preflight, and larger active-parameter rungs remain prohibited.
